headline: French Election Results Show Right-Wing Victory
content: France witnessed its center-right alliance triumph during the second round of departmental elections. This coalition comprises UMP led by former President Nicolas Sarkozy and Union of Democrats and Independents (UDI). According to early estimates, the right-wing parties secured between 65 and 71 out of France’s 101 departments while the Socialist Party retained control over up to 35 areas. Meanwhile, the National Front faced significant losses not winning any department despite expectations.
